task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a silver surgical instrument with the text "OLYMPUS" printed on its shaft entering from the right side of the circular frame. The instrument's tip is positioned in the center-left, interacting with a pale, fibrous tissue structure that has a yellowish hue and is surrounded by pinkish-red, vascularized tissue. Below the central area, a loop of bowel with a smooth, pink surface is visible. The instrument makes small, precise movements, appearing to dissect or manipulate the tissue. The background consists of the moist, glistening internal abdominal cavity, with various shades of pink, red, and yellow indicating different tissue types and potential inflammation or fat. The lighting is bright and focused on the central operative field, creating highlights on the wet surfaces.
